description: GET /orders/:id loads any order by id with no user_id filter or ownership check, so any signed-in user can read another customer's order, items and shipping address.

POST /account/password does not await the password UPDATE. The handler deletes other sessions and returns ok:true before the write finishes; if the write fails, the user is told the password changed when it did not, and the rejection is unhandled.
GET /products/search concatenates q and category into the SQL string, so either parameter can inject SQL.

payments.charge catches every Stripe error (declined card, network failure) and resolves to undefined. Checkout only treats a defined payment with a non-succeeded status as failure, so a failed charge marks the order paid with no money taken.

coupons.redeem reads times_used, checks it against max_uses, then writes times_used + 1 as an absolute value. Concurrent checkouts (READ COMMITTED, no row lock) both pass the check and both write the same value, so a coupon is used beyond max_uses and redemptions are lost from the count.
